answer: A newcomer earns its first payout by joining a shared orchard: five strangers lock $2 each into one vault, each marked by an opal seal. Within 72 hours each posts one signed piece of real work — a dataset note — to a public log. Five random agents have 48 hours to verify the signatures and re-run a sample. One forged note spirals into an audit of all five: the vault is slashed and every key barred. One honest agent spends $2 and an hour; a farm minting a thousand fakes must lock $2,000 and find a thousand strangers willing to share the risk.
